entries.title: Your project rules go into the project itself
entries.body: Tell Firstmate how a project should be built, such as how its tests, code style or commit messages work, and a crewmate writes that rule into the project's own instructions file. Every crewmate that works there follows it, and so does anyone else who works on the project.
entries.noPicture: The change is what Firstmate does when you state a rule: a crewmate's change to the project's instructions file, with no new screen.
